title: Iconosquare Alternatives for Visual Platform Analytics (2026)
summary: Iconosquare alternatives for visual platform analytics: 10 tools compared on Reels, Stories, competitor caps, data history and entry prices (October 2026).
body_markdown:
**TL;DR:** The best Iconosquare alternatives depend on which limit you are hitting. Iconosquare covers eight networks and, per its pricing page on October 12, 2026, tracks 5 competitors per profile with 1 month to 2 years of history by plan (Source:[Iconosquare pricing, 2026](https://www.iconosquare.com/pricing) ). Choose Socialinsider or Metricool for benchmarking depth, Later or Buffer for scheduling-first teams, a suite for inbox and reporting, and Dash Social or Emplifi at enterprise scale.


Iconosquare starts at €9 a month on yearly billing and has a free plan, so any reason to leave has to be specific (Source:[Iconosquare pricing, 2026](https://www.iconosquare.com/pricing) ). A switch only makes sense for one of three limits: too few competitor slots, too little history, or per-network detail you cannot find.


Pay for the wrong fix and you buy the same Stories gap at a higher price, because no tool can backfill what Meta stops serving. Below: what Iconosquare includes, what platform APIs cap, ten alternatives and seven steps to choose.


## What does Iconosquare cover and cost today?


Iconosquare is an analytics-first social media management tool covering eight networks: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest and YouTube (Source:[Iconosquare home, 2026](https://www.iconosquare.com/) ).

Prices are as shown on October 12, 2026, and we did not see monthly-billed prices, so we quote none. Iconosquare caps competitor tracking at 5 competitors per profile, and Starter, Launch and Scale list a 14-day free trial (Source:[Iconosquare pricing, 2026](https://www.iconosquare.com/pricing) ).


The analytics page lists 100+ metrics at post and page level, and its competitor reports cover follower growth, posting frequency and engagement. The pages we fetched do not document per-network YouTube or Pinterest metrics, which is a documentation gap, not proof the metrics are missing (Source:[Iconosquare analytics, 2026](https://www.iconosquare.com/features/analytics) ).


## What do platform APIs limit for all Iconosquare alternatives?


Every owned-analytics tool reads from the same platform APIs, so Meta, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest set most Reels, Stories and Pin metrics and history windows before any vendor adds storage.


**Owned analytics** : performance data from accounts you connect, such as reach, views, saves and watch time, limited by what each platform's API exposes.


-


**Meta:** The API returns data only for media owned by Instagram professional accounts, and some metrics are unavailable under 100 followers. Meta stores user metrics for up to 90 days, keeps Story media metrics available for 24 hours, and deprecated` impressions` for media created after July 2, 2024. (Source:[Meta media insights docs, 2026](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/reference/instagram-media/insights) ;[Meta Instagram insights docs, 2026](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/instagram-api-with-facebook-login/insights) )


-


**TikTok:** The pages we fetched did not confirm which account analytics fields third-party tools can read. (Source:[TikTok Display API overview, 2026](https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/display-api-overview) )


-


**YouTube:** The Analytics API supports targeted, real-time queries, and the Reporting API handles bulk reports. The pages we opened do not mention Shorts. (Source:[YouTube Analytics API, 2026](https://developers.google.com/youtube/analytics) )


-


**Pinterest:** Organic reporting has a 90-day look back for accounts and Pins, with lifetime reporting for most Pins. Some analytics require a business account. (Source:[Pinterest organic reporting, 2026](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/analytics-and-reports/organic-reporting/) )


Our inference: because Meta serves Story metrics for 24 hours, any tool's Stories history can only begin when you connect the account.

## Which Iconosquare alternatives suit analytics-first and scheduling-first teams?


Socialinsider and Metricool put analytics first, while Later, Buffer and Planable start from publishing and treat analytics as a tier or an add-on. Pick analytics-first if competitor depth is your complaint.


### Socialinsider


Every plan includes competitor benchmarking, and Adapt lists competitor accounts on "All platforms" with no cap stated. Follower history starts the day you add a profile because of a Facebook API limit. Adapt shows $82 a month beside $990 a year and a struck-through $1,188, so we read $82 as the yearly-billing rate. A 14-day trial needs no card (Source:[Socialinsider pricing, 2026](https://www.socialinsider.io/pricing) ).


### Metricool


Metricool's Instagram page lists Reels engagement rate, average reach, views, watch time and retention, plus Stories replies, taps and exits. The pricing page shows 5 competitor profiles on Free and up to 100 on Starter. Starter is from about $20 a month annual or $25 monthly for 5 brands, labels inferred. TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest metrics are not published on the pages we opened (Source:[Metricool Instagram analytics, 2026](https://metricool.com/instagram-analytics/) ;[Metricool pricing, 2026](https://metricool.com/pricing/) ).


### Later


Later keeps Story data for up to 3 months, which suggests it stores snapshots itself, since Meta serves Story insights for 24 hours (our inference). Analytics history runs 3 months on Starter, 1 year on Growth and 2 years on Scale, and benchmarking of up to 20 competitors is Scale only. Growth is $37.50 and Scale $82.50 a month billed yearly (Source:[Later Instagram analytics, 2026](https://later.com/instagram-analytics/) ;[Later pricing, 2026](https://later.com/pricing/) ).


### Buffer


Essentials is $5 per channel a month ($60 billed yearly) and Team is $10 ($120 billed yearly). For TikTok business profiles and YouTube Shorts, the channel table shows basic analytics only and marks advanced analytics "Not included" (Source:[Buffer pricing, 2026](https://buffer.com/pricing) ). For a three-way view, read[Buffer vs Later vs Sprout](https://syncly.app/blog/buffer-vs-later-vs-sprout-social-which-social-tool-fits-a-lean-team) .


### Planable


Planable sells analytics as an add-on, listed at $12 on plan cards and $14 in the table and FAQ, per workspace per month. It covers Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and Google Business Profile, not Pinterest, and includes "Competitor Analytics" with no count published (Source:[Planable pricing, 2026](https://planable.io/pricing/) ).


## Which Iconosquare alternatives fit suite and enterprise needs?


Sprout Social, Hootsuite and Agorapulse bundle analytics with publishing, inbox and reporting and price per seat or user, while Dash Social and Emplifi target larger teams.


### Sprout Social


Sprout lists Essentials at $79 per seat a month with 5 profiles, while the same page shows $99 per seat billed monthly, so we read $79 as the annual rate. Professional lists "extensive competitor, tag and paid insights" (Source:[Sprout Social pricing, 2026](https://sproutsocial.com/pricing/) ). Browse[Sprout Social alternatives](https://syncly.app/blog/sprout-social-alternatives) for suite-level comparisons.


### Hootsuite


Hootsuite's plan page shows no dollar figures, and its FAQ lists $99 for Standard, $199 for Professional and up to $399 for Advanced without a billing period. Benchmarking covers up to 5 competitors on Standard and 20 on Professional. Its analytics page covers Instagram Reels, feed posts and Stories, YouTube, and Pinterest ROI (Source:[Hootsuite plans, 2026](https://www.hootsuite.com/plans) ;[Hootsuite analytics, 2026](https://www.hootsuite.com/platform/analytics) ). For more suite options, see[Hootsuite alternatives](https://syncly.app/blog/hootsuite-alternatives) .


### Agorapulse


Agorapulse keeps history for 6 months on Standard, 12 on Professional and 24 on Advanced. Advanced lists competitor benchmarking, and the page also lists it as an add-on. Standard is from about $79 per user a month annual or $99 monthly (labels inferred), and Advanced Listening is a separate add-on (Source:[Agorapulse pricing, 2026](https://www.agorapulse.com/pricing/) ). For agency-focused options, see[Agorapulse alternatives](https://syncly.app/blog/agorapulse-alternatives) .


### Dash Social


Dash Social appears to be the former Dash Hudson: dashhudson.com redirects to dashsocial.com. Plans are Engage, Advance and Enterprise, with 14 days of free access per the FAQ. The comparison table shows "3 Competitors" in two plan columns, but we could not tell which plans (Source:[Dash Social pricing, 2026](https://www.dashsocial.com/pricing) ).


### Emplifi


Emplifi caps public profiles for benchmarking at 10 on Essential, 50 on Advanced and 100 on Intelligent, with extra profiles as an add-on on the top two. Essential starts at $1,249 a month and Advanced at $2,499, with no billing period published, and Intelligent is a custom quote. The page lists no trial (Source:[Emplifi pricing, 2026](https://emplifi.io/pricing) ). See[Emplifi alternatives](https://syncly.app/blog/emplifi-alternatives-6-tools-that-see-what-text-can-t) before you book one.


## How do you choose between Iconosquare alternatives?


Start from the single limit you are hitting, then test two shortlisted tools on one real account, because no vendor publishes a full metric list.


1.


List the networks and formats you must analyze.


2.


Count the competitors you need, then compare with the published caps.


3.


Decide how much history you need; Stories history starts at connection.


4.


Decide whether scheduling, inbox or approvals must live in the same tool.


5.


Check seats, profile limits and the billing basis: per seat, per set or per brand.


6.


Run each shortlisted trial on one real account and export one report.


7.


Only then decide whether you need listening for what owned analytics cannot see.


## What can owned analytics not see?


Owned analytics shows how your own posts performed, not the conversation happening off your accounts.


**Social listening** : monitoring public conversation and content about a topic, brand or hashtag beyond your own accounts, a different category from owned analytics and competitor benchmarking.

It organizes collection by query, and pricing is custom. It complements the tools above rather than replacing any of them. ## Key Takeaways


-


Iconosquare caps competitor tracking at 5 per profile and keeps 1 month to 2 years of history by plan, as of October 12, 2026.


-


Platform APIs sit under every tool: Meta serves Story metrics for 24 hours, Pinterest a 90-day look back.


-


Socialinsider and Metricool lead on benchmarking; Later and Buffer suit scheduling-first teams.


-


Test two tools on one real account and export a report before you commit.


Stay on Iconosquare unless a specific limit costs you: competitor slots, history length or per-network detail. The real choice is not which dashboard looks best, since the same platform APIs sit under all of them, but which limit you can live with.
